name: post-sast-node-tools
description: The Node/TypeScript SAST toolchain for `make security-tools` (tests/security/sast.sh node). It is its own npm project on purpose: apps/web's devDependencies are pinned by pnpm-lock.yaml, and a security tool added to the workspace would move that lockfile for every developer on every install. Everything here is an exact pin (no ^, no ~) and every package is recorded in ops/security/new-dependencies.json with its license, purpose and alternative, which is docs/40's first principle.
